ValidationRule.description: If Closed Lost Reason is Not 'Others' and Closed Lost Description are filled.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( $RecordType.Name = "Agent Acquisition", $RecordType.Name = "Renewal -Agent Acquisition"), NOT(INCLUDES(Closed_Lost_Reason__c,'Others')), NOT(ISBLANK( Closed_Lost_Description__c)) )
